Features

Heard & Seen Across the Table

The kit delivers clear video and audio for larger meeting rooms.

Tracking PTZ Camera

Auto framing, speaker tracking, presenter tracking and camera presets keep the right view on screen.

8-Mic Speakerphone

The UC BM45 picks up voices best within 4m and up to 8m away.

Daisy-Chain Audio

Extra UC BM45 speakerphones can be linked as optional add-ons to extend audio coverage.

4K Wired Sharing

Presenters share at up to 4K through the HDMI input on the XC25T.

Cable-Free Sharing

Content reaches the room through an optional WT13M or WT13S dongle or the MAXHUB Share app.

Control System Ready

Crestron, Extron, Q-SYS and Kramer control systems can be integrated with the kit.

Overview

Run From the Table, Maintained From the Desk

Teams Rooms runs on the XC25T mini-PC, and people start calls, share content and adjust the room from the TCP30T console. MAXHUB Pivot comes pre-installed, so IT managers can maintain and update the kit remotely.

  • The UC P30 connects to the mini-PC with a USB-C to USB-A cable.
  • One network cable carries the console connection back to the mini-PC.
  • A laptop plugged into the console’s USB-C port shares at 1080p.
  • Up to two touch consoles can control the room together.
  • AI noise reduction in the UC BM45 reduces background sound.
What's in the Kit

Matched Units for Video, Audio & Control

The camera, speakerphone, console and mini-PC each come with their own cables and accessories.

UC P30 Camera

Dual lenses and 12x optical zoom let the camera follow speakers and presenters.

In its box
  • 5m USB C-A cable
  • Power adapter
  • Remote control
  • Mounting kits
  • Quick start guide

UC BM45 Speakerphone

Eight microphones and a 5W speaker are housed in a 122mm table unit.

In its box
  • Table bracket
  • Power adapter
  • USB-C to USB-A cable
  • Ethernet cable

TCP30T Touch Console

An 11.6 inch capacitive screen with a PIR sensor wakes as people approach.

In its box
  • 1.8m USB-C cable
  • 7.5m Ethernet cable

XC25T Mini-PC

Teams Rooms runs on this 1.12kg mini-PC with an Intel Core i5-1240P.

In its box
  • Wall mount kit
  • Two 3m HDMI cables
  • Power adapter
  • Power cable

Optional Add-Ons

A WT13M or WT13S wireless dongle, the TCP30WM wall mount bracket and extra UC BM45 speakerphones for daisy chaining are optional.

FAQs

Common Questions on XT20-PS Kit

01What is included in the XT20-PS Kit?

The kit contains the XC25T mini-PC, the TCP30T touch console, the UC P30 camera and the UC BM45 speakerphone, each with its own cables and accessories.

02Which room sizes is it intended for?

The kit is intended for medium to large meeting rooms.

03Is the kit certified for Microsoft Teams?

Yes. It is a Microsoft Teams certified solution, and Teams Rooms runs on Windows 11 IoT Enterprise SAC on the mini-PC.

04How far does the speakerphone pick up voices?

The UC BM45 picks up voices best within 4m, with a maximum range of 8m.

05Can more speakerphones be added?

Additional UC BM45 units are optional and connect in a cascade through the RJ45 PoE ports.

06Does the kit work with room control systems?

It integrates with third-party control systems from Crestron, Extron, Q-SYS and Kramer.

07How can content be shared?

Presenters can share at up to 4K through the mini-PC’s HDMI input or at 1080p from a laptop on the console’s USB-C port. Wireless sharing uses an optional WT13M or WT13S dongle or the MAXHUB Share app.

08How is the kit kept up to date?

MAXHUB Pivot is pre-installed, so IT managers can maintain and update the kit remotely.
